Veterans Benefits: North Carolina fully exempts military retirement pay from state income tax beginning tax year 2021 (Session Law 2021-180) for retirees with 20+ years or medical retirement and eligible survivors. The state also excludes the first $45,000 of assessed home value for 100% permanently and totally service-connected disabled veterans and eligible surviving spouses.

Description: Jacksonville is a coastal-plain Marine Corps town adjoining Marine Corps Base Camp Lejeune and MCAS New River, one of the largest Marine concentrations in the country. It offers an in-city VA outpatient clinic, North Carolina's exemption of military retirement pay, affordable housing, and Walmart access. Tradeoffs include a below-average violent-crime rate but elevated property crime, humid summers with Atlantic hurricane exposure, and no local Costco.
